quirks.description: Sanity image URLs: cdn.sanity.io/images/<projectId>/<dataset>/<hash>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. Image ref in URL drops 'image-' prefix. Optional vanity filename appended as extra path segment.
quirks.workaround: Parse project ID and dataset from URL path. Strip vanity filename path segment if present.

quirks.description: Sanity supports hotspot-aware cropping via ?fp-x= and ?fp-y= focal point params (0.0-1.0). Crop data is stored per-usage, not per-asset.
quirks.workaround: When images appear cropped differently than expected, check for focal point data.

quirks.description: ?auto=format serves best format: AVIF > WebP > original, via Accept header negotiation. First few AVIF requests may get WebP while async AVIF encoding completes.
quirks.workaround: Always include ?auto=format for production. For download, omit to get original format.

quirks.description: SVG images pass through CDN untransformed. Width/height/format params have no effect. SVGs with <use> may have tags stripped.
quirks.workaround: Download SVGs as-is without transform params. Check Content-Type to detect SVGs.

quirks.description: Sanity generates LQIP (20px-wide base64 PNG) and BlurHash strings in asset metadata. Accessed via GROQ: asset->metadata.lqip.
quirks.workaround: Use LQIP as blurDataURL in Next.js Image for placeholder blur-up effect.

quirks.description: Assets cached indefinitely — URLs are content-addressed (SHA-1 hash). Content change produces new URL. Images >10MB bypass CDN cache.
quirks.workaround: Extracted image URLs are stable. No cache-busting needed.
